integrity: Complete exact finite exhaustive checks by distinct Python and C++17 implementations and an elementary Cayley/tessellation proof. Internal review only. No external certification or exhaustive literature guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement for the sixteen-vertex standard Shrikhande graph, not arbitrary strongly regular graphs. The triangulated torus is a known graph embedding; the new claim concerns the minimum ordinary domination optimizer family and its exact shattering complex. An accessible 2019 article claims ordinary domination number four; explicit verified three-element dominators show the conflicting assertion does not apply to the standard Cayley graph. Historical priority conditional on inspected sources; independent audit not performed.
title: The toroidal shattering complex of minimum domination in the Shrikhande graph
